name: Boss Picks Pig
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Fill the trough and tap the pig that won’t eat.
Add wings and tap the pig that can’t fly.
Fill the pool and tap the muddy pig.
Use the ghost costume and tap the scared pig.
Start the treadmill and tap the pig that falls.
Give the book and tap the confused pig.
Tap the phone and remove the low-balance pig.
Play the violin and tap the untalented pig.
Play bad music and tap the pig that likes it.
Give uniforms and tap the aggressive pig.
Tap the final pigs and remove the jealous one.
